newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-U.S. firm to drill offshore South Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-U.S. firm to drill offshore South Australia.

text.p: Canyon (Australia) Pty Ltd, an affiliate of Texas based oil and gas explorer Wagner and Brown Ltd, will begin a A$15 million offshore drilling programme in Gulf St Vincent, the South Australian government said.
Energy Minister Stephen Baker said the programme, to drill two petroleum exploration wells, followed offshore seismic surveys in 1993 and 1994 in Canyon's petroleum exploration licence (PEL) 53.
The programme, due to begin within the next few weeks, was expected to take 35 days, he said.
